title: Memory and counter integrity under faults: MSPLIM in both worlds, secrets in an ECC-NMI bank, an authentication tag over the page-123 live record set, and a non-trivial page-124 encoding
threat: A fault-induced stack-pointer corruption or deep recursion silently overwrites page-123/124 buffers (no MSPLIM anywhere); an SRAM bit-flip in master_secret/SLOT_CACHE corrupts silently (ECC double-error NMI off), which SLasH-DSA shows is exploitable during hash-based signing; a glitch or flash manipulation that drops the newest page-123 tally record lowers local_offchain_count with no detector; page 124 is a unary count of zero quadwords where an erased page decodes to 0 attempts (the exact 0xFF read-as-zero shape Trezor was defeated by via USB voltage manipulation).
proposal: (1) Program MSPLIM_S (and PSPLIM if used) 256 B above the stack base in the secure world's startup and in the FSBL; overflow ⇒ UsageFault ⇒ existing zeroize+reset path. (2) Place master_secret, SLOT_CACHE and the sign buffers in SRAM2 (or an ECC-enabled region per #48), enable RAMCFG ECC double-error NMI and route it to zeroize + handle_fault. (3) Page 123: maintain an HMAC-SHA256 (DHUK-rooted via saes_cmac) over the folded set of live per-slot counters written as the last quadword of each commit and verified on every read; mismatch ⇒ refuse to sign + handle_fault (Trezor STORAGE_TAG). (4) Page 124: replace the plain zero-quadword with a Hamming-structured marker (e.g. 01/10-expanded attempt index + complement) so neither 0x00…00 nor 0xFF…FF quadwords are well-formed, decode every copy and require agreement; keep the SE counters as primary. (5) Kani/rainbow fault-model tests for both decoders (the existing Kani work covers logic, not stuck-at reads).
rationale: These are shipped Trezor properties (MSPLIM, storage auth tag, blockwise 01/10 PIN counter) and a ship-blocker (#48); page-124 is the user-facing 10-attempt bound and page-123 is the off-chain cap, both read by FI-critical gates. Trezor explicitly justifies a simplified counter encoding when SE counters exist — pq1 is in the same position — but not an unencoded one.

vendor_precedent: Trezor sysutils.c:91-95 (MSPLIM), storage.c:253-388 (auth tag over protected keys), storage/pinlogs_blockwise.h:8-87 (01/10 expansion + all-copies-agree), docs/storage/index.md:176-215 (0xFFFFFFFF counter defeated by USB voltage manipulation).
risks: Changing the page-124/123 layouts re-provisions every bench board and touches the Kani/Miri-proven decoders and the E2E pin-gate harnesses; the page-123 tag adds 16 B per commit against the 16 B/increment log budget (compaction cadence halves).
